scene: You glide out of the cloud cable pod into breezy Hanok Sky Village.
picture: Flat side view. Along the level tiled boardwalk, a docked glass cloud cable pod rests on the far left. A young Chinese woman with a black ponytail in a red bomber jacket and white roller skates stands just right of it. Next sits a steaming rice-cake cart, followed by kimchi jars, and a glowing hologram pop stage.
shown: a steaming wooden rice-cake cart with red paper lanterns on the left
a tidy patch of glazed brown kimchi onggi pots on the right
a glowing neon hologram pop stage with dancing light figures on the far right

variants.scene: Your skates roll onto the wooden deck under a twilight mountain sky.
Cool evening air greets you as {tune} hums softly in your mind.
Lanterns glow warmly above the village rooftops as sweet street aromas drift by.
